title: Rise, turn, consequence

members.role: R18 first: a dashed ring lands on the peak as the climb reaches it and holds (E56: a ring on a chart circles a datum)
R18 first: on the fall's verb the line draws on from the peak to the trough
R18 first: a light runs the fall from the peak to the trough, its comet head leading, as the size of the fall is said
R18 first: the fall's size is written at the trough, in neg ink below the point, as the light arrives - the page's own arithmetic
as the turn is spoken the chart makes room - one affine shrink toward its anchor, every mark (ring, light, drop) kept in place
a hub lands in the room - the thing that survived - and what hangs off it branches out, each rim node on the word that names it
on the consequence's last word the link that did NOT survive fails - the X on its spoke (T17), the rest standing

does: After the fall is quantified the chart parks to make room, a hub lands for what survived and its consequences branch out on their words, and the one link that did not survive fails.

use_when.act: EXPLAINS - after a quantified fall, what survived it (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R19)
use_when.shape: series -> named things: a line with its fall already ringed, lit and written, then 3-8 named consequences
use_when.use: the sentence after a crash names what kept working (H row 13: 'It was the steel ... The trains ran ... the towns kept growing ... The paper stopped pretending')
use_when.dont: the consequences are unsourced (the guide's don't); the fall has not been quantified on screen first (run peak-fall-magnitude on its own sentence); a consequence the sentence does not name
